## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The endpoint rejects requests without a valid admin key with 401 or 403 and...

The system SHALL ensure that the endpoint rejects requests without a valid admin key with 401 or 403 and records an audit row with admin_key_fp for both accepted and rejected calls.

#### Scenario: The endpoint rejects requests without a valid admin key with 401 or 403 and...

WHEN `add-admin-endpoint-for-browser-session-sync` is implemented
THEN The endpoint rejects requests without a valid admin key with 401 or 403 and records an audit row with admin_key_fp for both accepted and rejected calls.

### Requirement: A valid request patches only the session keys and leaves every other key at...

The system SHALL ensure that a valid request patches only the session keys and leaves every other key at secret/newsletter byte-identical.

#### Scenario: A valid request patches only the session keys and leaves every other key at...

WHEN `add-admin-endpoint-for-browser-session-sync` is implemented
THEN A valid request patches only the session keys and leaves every other key at secret/newsletter byte-identical.

### Requirement: No cookie value appears in logs, audit rows, or error responses

The system SHALL ensure that no cookie value appears in logs, audit rows, or error responses.

#### Scenario: No cookie value appears in logs, audit rows, or error responses

WHEN `add-admin-endpoint-for-browser-session-sync` is implemented
THEN No cookie value appears in logs, audit rows, or error responses.
